name: vtu-media-club
description: VTU Media Club — Student Film, Photography & Motion Collective

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive:true}); ['index.html','admin.html','vercel.json','site-data.json'].forEach(f => fs.existsSync(f) && fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/'+f)); ['assets','src'].forEach(d => fs.existsSync(d) && fs.cpSync(d, 'dist/'+d, {recursive:true})); console.log('Static site build complete for Vercel.');"
